definitions.explanation: A formal way to say 'today,' commonly used in business settings, announcements, and formal speech.

examples.japanese: {本日|ほんじつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ご{来店|らいてん}→ご来店：24462_goraiten⟧⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for visiting our store today.

examples.japanese: {本日|ほんじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{本日|ほんじつ}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{新|しん}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We will begin our new service starting today.

notes:
{本日|ほんじつ} is the formal equivalent of ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧. It is used in polite and official contexts where ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧ would sound too casual.

USAGE:
- Business emails and communications
- Store and restaurant announcements
- Formal speeches and ceremonies
- Written notices and signs

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {本日|ほんじつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜: today ~ (opening a formal statement)
- {本日|ほんじつ}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧: starting from today
- {本日|ほんじつ}⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧: today only
- {本日|ほんじつ}⟦{休業|きゅうぎょう}→休業：11541_kyuugyou⟧: closed today

FORMALITY SCALE:
- ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧: neutral/casual (everyday conversation)
- {本日|ほんじつ}: formal (business, announcements, ceremonies)

Note: In spoken Japanese, using {本日|ほんじつ} in casual conversation sounds stiff and overly formal.
